welcomeHeadline.description: Main headline on the post-install welcome tab

welcomeSubline.message: Save the emails you write again and again, then drop them into a new message with one click. Attachments and recipients come along.
welcomeSubline.description: Sub-headline under the welcome tab headline

welcomeCtaCreate.description: Primary button on the welcome tab; opens the options page

welcomeCtaDocs.description: Secondary button on the welcome tab; links to the usage guide

welcomeStepsTitle.description: Heading of the getting-started section on the welcome tab

welcomeStep1Body.message: Open the template manager and save a text you send often. Subject, body, recipients and file attachments are all part of the template.

welcomeStep2Body.message: Click the TemplateWing button in the compose toolbar, or right-click in the message body and choose “Insert Template”.

welcomeStep3Body.message: Pick a template and everything is filled in at once. For the first nine templates you can also press Ctrl+Shift+1 to Ctrl+Shift+9.

welcomeFeaturesTitle.description: Heading of the feature section on the welcome tab

welcomeFeatureAttachmentsBody.message: Files are stored with the template and get attached automatically every time you insert it.

welcomeFeatureVariablesBody.message: Placeholders like {DATE}, {RECIPIENT_FIRSTNAME} or {SENDER_NAME} are replaced when you insert the template.

welcomeFeatureConditionalsBody.message: With {IF recipient.domain=="acme.com"} … {ELSE} … {ENDIF} the same template can show different text depending on who you are writing to.

welcomeFeaturePromptsBody.message: {PROMPT:Order number} and {CHOICE:Tone:formal|casual} open a small dialog before insertion, so you can fill in whatever changes each time.

welcomeFeatureDefaultsTitle.description: Feature card title: default template per account

welcomeFeatureDefaultsBody.message: Pick a template that appears automatically in every new message for a given identity. Replies and forwards are left alone.
welcomeFeatureDefaultsBody.description: Feature card body: default template per account

welcomeFeaturePrivacyBody.message: Everything is kept in Thunderbird’s local storage. No account, no telemetry, no network requests.

welcomeSupportTitle.description: Heading of the donation section on the welcome tab

welcomeSupportBody.message: I build it in my free time. If it saves you some of yours, a small donation helps.
